sources.notes: LotL: WinNetMon Direction=outbound primary. Sysmon often lands as sourcetype=XmlWinEventLog with EventCode 1/3 (not only the long Operational sourcetype). host may be UPPERCASE short name; Computer may be FQDN — use case-insensitive match on host/Computer.

placeholder_conventions.host: Primary affected host. Notable often uses destination; alias map resolves host/destination/destination_ip.
placeholder_conventions.user: UserName from WinNetMon / User from Sysmon; notable renames to user.
placeholder_conventions.destination: Same as host for this Linux SSH key rule (rule renames host as dest).
placeholder_conventions.process: LOLBin path/name from notable (ProcessName/Image). Rule renames ProcessName as process.
placeholder_conventions.dest_ip: RemoteAddress from WinNetMon; notable may expose dest_ip after rename.
